value: P(win the boss | entry HP) is causal and per boss, not a flat price: boss replays varying only HP give 0.35 at 30 HP to 0.95 at 80 (all bosses; 87% of the observational slope), Slime Boss near-sure from 40, the Guardian a cliff near 50, Hexaghost a slow climb to 0.90; so HP is worth most where a boss's step sits.
